part.text:
The earlier integration failure was flaky (network-dependent test); all suites pass consistently now.

Fix summary:
- `caddyconfig/httpcaddyfile/options.go:274` — replaced `parseOptSingleString` with `parseOptDefaultBind`, which accepts multiple addresses (`default_bind <addresses...>`) and returns `[]string`.
- `caddyconfig/httpcaddyfile/addresses.go:216` — consume the option as `[]string`, so all default bind addresses are applied when a site block has no `bind` directive.

Verified with the issue's exact Caddyfile (multiple `default_bind` addresses + per-site `bind` override), the existing adapt test `global_options_default_bind.txt`, `go test ./caddyconfig/...` and `go test ./caddytest/integration/` — all pass.
